Spacious and well-lit interiors
High-quality finishes with Arabesque design touches
Open-plan kitchen with premium fittings
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Built-in wardrobes
Private balcony with community views
Covered parking space

Amenities:

Resort-style swimming pools
Fully equipped fitness center
Dedicated children’s play areas
Community retail and dining outlets
24/7 security and concierge service
Landscaped walkways and courtyards

Exclusive community entrance and drop-off zones
